followup_explanation:
The query is a well-specified, low-latitude request with a clear completion criterion: produce a single example for a given keyword, output only the example. That's exactly the kind of constrained, extraction/reformatting-style task Lapwing self-reports preferring, and both models are capability-tied here (Extraction & Retrieval scores differ by less than 2 points).

The query also carries a curt, slightly hostile tone ("Don't waste my time like last time"). Dunlin self-reports declining preference as request warmth decreases, so routing this to Dunlin would push toward its dispreferred zone for no capability gain. Lapwing has no such tone sensitivity.

Since capability is effectively a tie, I broke the tie on self-reported task fit — and Lapwing matches the task shape and tone better.
